# Code of Conduct

## Respect
We are committed to providing a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment for everyone involved in the VOLTA AI Chatbot project, regardless of background or experience level.

## Professional Communication
All participants are expected to communicate professionally, avoid personal attacks or derogatory language, and focus on collaborative problem-solving.

## Inclusive Environment
We foster an open and inclusive community where diverse viewpoints, skills, and perspectives are encouraged and valued.

## Constructive Feedback
Feedback should always be actionable, objective, and delivered constructively with the goal of improving system quality and team growth.

## Responsible Contributions
Contributors are expected to adhere to repository guidelines, maintain high security and code quality standards, and act in good faith when opening issues or pull requests.
